R29 a refusal events answers (CAPTURE_NOT_HELD, NOT_A_REGISTER) is counted in the tick's failed with its reason, and the follow stays due
R29 a read by refreshRegister (an account-gated register) hands its capture to events too, stating what events answered

R30 from and to bound both lanes' dated items; the group lane asks the deadlines with the viewer and those days
R30 an event placed nowhere is listed in the proceeding's lane with its undetermined date stated; a proceeding with no action reads no deadlines
R30 each lane holds at most 500 items with truncated: events' truncation is carried, and the group lane stops at 500 of 520 across pages of actions
R30 an absent or unseen proceeding answers as R29 refuses (NO_SUCH_ENTITY, one answer), and an entity of another kind NOT_A_PROCEEDING; a bad day is refused BAD_PROCEEDING_DATES; nothing is written
R30 the proceeding's lane is what events.eventsFor answers to the viewer: an event whose only attestation the viewer cannot see is left out
